statement: The v9 protocol is frozen before multi-seed execution. All evaluation contracts, feature schemas, missing-data thresholds, candidate bounds, and promotion criteria are immutable. If the honest outcome is that HAR beats every neural candidate, that outcome is deployed and published as the result.

reasons_for_exclusion: Contradictory identity: winning_family='elasticnet' while architecture.encoder_family='tcn' and weights.pt holds TCN weights.
Single-fold smoke evidence presented as if it were a robust multi-fold evaluation.
Reversed QLIKE arguments: produced while qlike_losses arguments were passed realized-first.
Incomplete provenance: no binding to a full Git SHA, data snapshot, universe snapshot, or split manifest.

target.rationale: Log-variance is closer to Gaussian and unconstrained on the real line, so a residual model can operate additively without ad-hoc positivity clamping.

horizons.rule: A candidate must show skill at EVERY required horizon. A loss at any required horizon cannot be offset by gains elsewhere.

rules: transformations fitted on training data only
cross-sectional statistics use only securities observable at the origin
missingness indicators explicit
every feature carries an available_at timestamp
exact column order is frozen
no raw future-scaled price level as a central input

periods.definition: Periods are the realized date ranges implied by the 70/15/15 split over sorted forecast origins once the licensed panel exists. They are not chosen independently of the split.
rules: periods must be contiguous and non-overlapping in origin time
purge and embargo mean the realized date ranges may contain gaps at the boundaries; this is expected and must not be back-filled
once the split manifest is written at stage 4 the periods are immutable
the sealed test period is never used for training, early stopping, hyperparameter choice, or candidate selection
all three periods must be published in the certification record even when the outcome is negative

asset_transfer_policy.rule: Unseen-asset transfer is an evaluation surface, never a tuning surface. An asset used to pick a candidate is not an unseen asset.
asset_transfer_policy.contamination_rule: NMM and MSFT are eligible as transfer assets only after an explicit contamination audit confirms they were never used for feature selection, scaler fitting, or hyperparameter search in this or any prior cycle.

rules: missing values are never imputed without an accompanying explicit indicator feature
missingness indicators are fitted on train only
a security with insufficient history at an origin produces no sample at that origin rather than a padded sample
no forward-fill across non-trading sessions
halts and missing sessions are preserved explicitly, not smoothed away
cross-sectional statistics degrade gracefully and record their effective sample size
a forecast must not be emitted from a window whose missingness exceeds the frozen threshold (5%)
missing_data_policy.abstention: If required inputs are missing at serving time the model abstains. It does not emit a forecast built on substituted values.

seeding.rule: Deterministic families produce exactly one record per fold at seed 0. Replicating them across neural seeds is forbidden because it fabricates evidence volume and corrupts uncertainty estimates.

promotion_gates.rule: Every gate must pass. Selection is never based on an average that can hide a failing horizon.

rules: a family name describes the actual architecture, not the aspiration
an identity is bound to a content digest; the same name may never refer to different weights
no v9 identity may reuse a v7 or v8 weight or identity
development candidates carry artifact_role=development_candidate and are never named as certified models

candidate_families.conditional_rule: dlinear is included only if a mathematically genuine implementation exists. A linear model relabelled as DLinear must not be evaluated.
candidate_families.excluded_rule: garch_lstm is excluded until a genuinely trained recurrent residual hybrid exists. A fixed GARCH/HAR blend is not a GARCH-LSTM.

experiment_budget.corrective_cycle_condition: permitted only when the primary neural cycle fails for a documented implementation defect, not merely because it lost
experiment_budget.rule: Do not tune indefinitely against the development period. After the budget is spent, deploy the qualifying champion, else the qualifying baseline, else retain abstention.

decision_hierarchy.condition: news candidate passes standalone gates AND adds incremental value over the frozen numeric companion AND beats all negative controls
numeric candidate passes every promotion gate
no learned candidate qualifies, but a baseline does
no candidate meets operational and evidence gates

news_controls.qualification_rule: News qualifies only if it improves over the frozen numeric companion AND beats every negative control across all required horizons.

data_eligibility.blocker: A certified market model requires an attested point-in-time constituent source and a licensed market panel permitting training and derived-model use. Until then all results are development evidence only.
data_eligibility.labelling_requirement: Every artifact produced under this protocol while data is ineligible must carry evidence_role=development_diagnostic_only and certification_eligible=false.

terminal_outcomes: A: learned numeric or news model passes and is deployed
B: no learned model passes, a certified baseline is deployed and the negative result is published
C: no candidate meets gates, production retains explicit abstention and the result is published
notes: This protocol is frozen BEFORE any v9 model selection so that the research question cannot be changed after seeing an inconvenient result. If the honest outcome is that HAR beats every neural candidate, that outcome is reported as the result.
